newsitem.title: USA: Datascope says FDA lifts restrictions.
newsitem.headline: Datascope says FDA lifts restrictions.

text.p: Datascope Corp said on Thursday that the Food and Drug Administration has lifted its application integrity policy restrictions and that the agency will likely resume its review of all pending and future marketing submissions by two of its units.
The move clears the way for review of submissions by the company's patent monitoring division and InterVascular subsidiary, it said.
The company said it expects the agency to resume review of its previous submission for pre-market approval of InterGard, which are knitted collagen coated grafts.
In addition, InterVascular plans to submit two new 510k applications during the current fiscal qaurter covering its InterGard surgical patches and woven collagen coated grafts, the company said.
The company said it also plans to submit in the next several months new 510k applications for Accutorr Plus, a non-invasive blood pressure monitor, and for System 96, an intra-aortic balloon pump.
The FDA had applied the integrity policy review to the company in April 1995.
